title: 第十一章 剑仙
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
她对上那双怨毒的眼，心下一片了然，谢临浩资质平庸，比不得两位兄长能得家族倾力栽培，子嗣天资也远远不及。

    他困于金丹中期数百年，难道是大限将至，修为毫无寸进，如今才这般不管不顾？两个靠着丹药堆砌修为的女儿，一个止步筑基前期，一个才炼气六层。

    反观大房，家主谢临坤是元婴后期，其子百岁出头便已结丹，长女亦早早突破金丹。

    而原身父亲谢临珏天资最高，失踪前已是炼虚期，原身更是罕见的变异冰灵根。在父亲失踪后，家族绝大部分资源已向大房倾斜。

    难怪这人眼中恨意如此之深，她唇角轻勾，冷眼看戏。见谢临浩的目光又落在她身上，他袖中拳头紧攥着，她心中暗想，原身小叔怨气真的好大。

    “二哥当年自私，为了个女人，竟不管家族死活，硬闯有去无回的上古迷域，害得家族损失顶尖战力，资源自此捉襟见肘。”谢临浩双眼通红，低声说出这一句，全场瞬间安静，又对家主愤恨道，“我就这两个女儿，此生也不会再有希望，二哥如今不在，大哥你也不管吗？”

    听到涉及原身父母，谢清猗竖起耳朵。不过这人说得也没错，修士境界越高，子嗣越艰难，此乃天道法则。

    谢临坤眉头紧锁，脸黑如墨，沉声呵道：“三弟，现在怎能当着真尊的面说这个。”随即他朝着安芦冉双手一拱，“真尊莫怪，让您看笑话了。”

    不待他话说完，那谢临浩如破罐子破摔般又说道：“我不趁着琼羽真尊在时说，你定然又是推来推去，既然我女儿资质一般，大哥不如为你两个侄女道侣之事筹谋一下。”

    他哭丧着脸，眼眶湿润，“真尊，您定要管管啊！您是我二哥师妹，不能不管我啊。”

    谢清猗大开眼界，这人怕是真被寿元将至逼急眼了，见家族冷漠，又被安姑姑所厌，竟还抬出原身父亲的名号，一边给女儿找捷径，一边给自己寻一线突破的契机，他想的还是满美的。

    “昕儿，你同你道侣说下，这次回仙府，先带之涵，之妙一起回去。”谢临坤面容微微泛红，目光躲闪，不敢看安芦冉，轻咳一声，“怎会不管三弟你与两个侄女的前途，你多心了。”

    “是，父亲。”谢昕儿面色也不太好看，还是应了下来。

    安芦冉彷若未闻般，不去理会谢家众人，只是抬眼望了望天边那隐约浮现的灵光，转而对着谢清猗欣然浅笑，语气恢复温柔：“猗宝儿，姑姑同你一道回天极仙府，正好我也有事要办。”

    “好啊，好啊～姑姑和我一起回去，我就不无聊了！”谢清猗立刻抱住她的胳膊，笑盈盈地撒娇……她刚来到这个世界还是很没安全感的，遇到一个对自己好的人，也不想分开。

    合体期大能的威压果真骇人，一发怒竟引得天地变色，真不知合体之上的老怪物又该是何等恐怖。没想到还能顺带吃上谢三老爷家这么个大瓜。

    她悄悄瞥了眼那家主谢临坤，只见他面色难堪，和一旁谢临浩的喜悦之情，呈明显区别，轻轻摇了摇头，谢家人可真是一言难尽啊。

    这时，家主夫人荣怀音匆匆从侧殿赶来，裙裾窸窣。她附在谢临坤耳边低语几句，语速很快。

    谢清猗心中微紧，手指紧紧陷入掌心，难道这荣怀音要说出昨夜之事了？

    只见谢临坤脸色一沉，强压着不悦，对那笑靥明媚的少女开口道：“清猗，你自幼父母失踪，我与你大伯母定是要管你的。哪家世家小姐，如你这般任性行事，当面驳斥长辈安排？”

    安芦冉狐疑地看了眼匆忙赶来的荣怀音，又望向身旁瞬间收起笑容的谢清猗，随即冷声向谢临坤问道：“不知谢家主所言，究竟是何事？”
content_en:
When she met those resentful eyes, she knew clearly in her heart that Xie Linhao's qualifications were mediocre. He was not as good as his two elder brothers who could receive the family's efforts to cultivate him, and his children's talents were also far inferior.

    He has been stuck in the middle stage of the Golden Core for hundreds of years. Could it be that his end is approaching and he has not made any progress in his cultivation, so he is so indifferent now? Of the two daughters who relied on pills to build their cultivation, one was in the early stages of foundation building, and the other was only at the sixth level of Qi refining.

    On the other hand, in Dafang, the head of the family, Xie Linkun, was in the late Nascent Soul stage. His son had already formed the elixir in his early 100s, and the eldest daughter had also broken through the golden elixir early.

    The original father, Xie Linjue, was the most talented. He was already in the Void Refining stage before his disappearance, and his original body had a rare mutated ice spirit root. After his father disappeared, most of the family's resources have been allocated to Dafang.

    No wonder the hatred in this person's eyes was so deep. The corners of her lips curled up slightly, watching the show with cold eyes. Seeing Xie Linhao's eyes falling on her again, his fists clenched in his sleeves, she thought to herself that her original uncle was really resentful.

    "Second brother was selfish back then. For the sake of a woman, he didn't care about the life and death of the family. He forced his way into the ancient mysterious realm where there was no return. As a result, the family lost its top combat power and its resources were stretched." Xie Linhao's eyes turned red and he whispered this sentence. The whole place fell silent for an instant, and he said angrily to the head of the family, "I have two daughters who will never have hope in this life. Second brother is not here now, so don't you care about me, eldest brother?"

    Xie Qingyi pricked up his ears when he heard that his original parents were involved. But this person is right. The higher the level of a monk, the more difficult it is for heirs. This is the law of heaven.

    Xie Linkun frowned, his face was as dark as ink, and he said in a deep voice: "Third brother, how can you say this in front of Zhenzun now." Then he arched his hands towards An Luran, "Zhenzun, don't blame me, you are laughing."

    Before he could finish his words, Xie Linhao said again as if a jar had been broken: "If I didn't take advantage of Qiong Yu's presence to speak, you would have pushed her back and forth again. Since my daughter's qualifications are average, why don't you make some plans for your two nieces and Taoist companions?"

    He cried sadly, his eyes moist, "Zhenzun, you must take care of me! You are my second brother and junior sister, you can't ignore me."

    Xie Qingyi's eyes were opened. This man was probably really anxious because of his longevity. Seeing the indifference of his family and being disgusted by Aunt An, he even used the name of his original father to find shortcuts for his daughter and an opportunity for himself to make a breakthrough. His thoughts were full of happiness.

    "Xin'er, please tell your Taoist companion that when you return to the Immortal Mansion this time, you should take Zhihan and Zhimiao back together first." Xie Linkun's face turned slightly red, his eyes dodge, and he did not dare to look at An Luran. He coughed lightly, "Why don't you care about the future of you and your two nieces, third brother? You are too worried."

    "Yes, father." Xie Xin'er's face didn't look too good, but she still agreed.

    An Luran acted as if he had not heard anything, and ignored everyone in the Xie family. He just raised his eyes to look at the vague spiritual light on the horizon. He then smiled happily at Xie Qingyi, and his tone returned to gentleness: "Yi Bao'er, my aunt is returning to Tianji Immortal Mansion with you. It just so happens that I also have something to do."

    "Okay, okay~ If my aunt comes back with me, I won't be bored anymore!" Xie Qingyi immediately hugged her arm, smiling coquettishly... She was still very insecure when she first came to this world, and she didn't want to separate when she met someone who was good to her.

    The coercion of the powerful in the combined stage is really terrifying, and when he gets angry, the color of the world changes. I really don't know how terrifying the old monster in the combined stage must be. I didn't expect to be able to eat such a big melon from Mr. Xie San's family.

    She quietly glanced at the head of the family, Xie Linkun, and saw that his expression was embarrassed, which was obviously different from the joy of Xie Linhao beside him. She shook her head slightly. It was really hard to describe the Xie family.

    At this time, the wife of the housekeeper, Rong Huaiyin, hurried from the side hall, her skirt rustling. She whispered a few words into Xie Linkun's ear, speaking very quickly.

    Xie Qingyi's heart tightened slightly, and his fingers dug tightly into his palms. Could it be that Rong Huaiyin was going to tell what happened last night?

    Xie Linkun's face darkened, he suppressed his displeasure, and said to the girl with a bright smile: "Qingyi, your parents have been missing since you were young, and your eldest aunt and I must take care of you. Which young lady from aristocratic family, behaves as willfully as you do, and refutes the arrangements of the elders face to face?"

    An Luran glanced suspiciously at Rong Huaiyin, who was rushing over, and then at Xie Qingyi, who instantly stopped smiling. Then he asked Xie Linkun in a cold voice, "I wonder what the head of the Xie family is talking about?"
